description: The jingle for src/branding ZooraSting: a harp and string shimmer, the lydian motif on vibes and harp landing on the logo hit, two notes under the wordmark and tag line; fades out by 4.0 s with the picture.
usage: npx remotion render src/branding/index.ts ZooraSting out/brand/zoora-ai/sting.mp4 --props='{"jingle":"audio/music/intro-sting-zoora.wav"}'
instruments: VCSL Kawai piano (and a reversed bloom)
selfReview: A harp and string shimmer rises from frame 6, and the lydian motif lands on the logo hit (frame 54) with an F-add9 bloom; two notes sit under the wordmark and tag (frames 70 and 78). Critic round 1 (2026-11-24): the MuseScore celesta (weak sample credit, a late tag note) is gone: hard-mallet vibraphone doubled by the harp carries the motif, over the soft vibes. The hit labels now use Zoora wording. It loses 2.0 LU on the phone model. Listen for whether the reversed piano bloom reads as intended or as a swoosh.
